story.iWant: to create, view, edit, and manage residents with enforced household assignment
story.soThat: the village registry stays accurate, household rosters remain synchronized, and downstream modules can rely on consistent resident data

tasks.task: Create resident form and detail views
Implement offline and error handling patterns

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Residents list page shows first and last name, gender, household, contact details, and status badges with sort and pagination (10/25/50/100 rows).
Residents list offers search and filters by name (partial match) and household, preserving selections across pagination.
“Add Resident” form requires first name, last name, DOB, gender, household assignment, dormitory room number when applicable, and validates optional phone/email using validateForm.
If no households exist, creation is blocked and a message directs the user to create a household first.
Successful resident creation writes to Appwrite, displays success feedback, refreshes the list, and updates the linked household’s occupant count.
Resident detail view displays personal information, household membership, and an activity placeholder with edit/delete controls gated by RBAC.
Edit flow pre-populates resident data and saves changes back to Appwrite while keeping household occupancy synchronized.
Delete flow prompts confirmation, prevents removal when the resident is the sole household head, and logs metadata through useErrorHandler.
Household occupant lists remain accurate by syncing on resident create/update/delete events and drive dashboard widgets.
Residents list quick actions respect permissions; unauthorized users get read-only views with masked contact data.
Resident mutations queue offline via Dexie and replay on reconnect with sync notifications and error handling.
Manual verification covers responsive design (≥320px), keyboard navigation, and sub-2s 3G load performance.

ideas.idea: Confirm residents list displays required columns, pagination sizes, and status badge rendering.
Apply name and household filters, paginate across pages, and verify filters persist across navigation.
Validate form error handling for missing required fields and incorrect phone/email formats using validateForm.
Remove all households and ensure creation flow blocks with CTA directing to Households module.
Create a resident, verify Appwrite document is written, success toast appears, list refreshes, and household count increments.
Open resident detail view, confirm personal info, household data, and that RBAC hides actions for unauthorized users.
Edit resident data (including household change) and ensure updates persist with accurate occupant synchronization.
Attempt deletion for household head and confirm guard prevents removal with explanatory messaging.
Add, update, then delete residents while observing linked household occupants and dashboard summaries stay in sync.
Log in with varying permissions to verify quick actions show/hide and contact info masks for read-only roles.
Queue create/update/delete actions while offline, reconnect, and confirm automatic sync with notifications and error fallback.
Execute responsive and performance checks (mobile width, keyboard navigation, throttled 3G) capturing timing metrics.
